name: Heart City Stories Ep. 1: Friendly Favours
source:
You just moved to a city and made your first friend: a friendly neighbour from your apartment building named Yuka. You both hit it off, but will you end up as just friends, or more?

[From [url=https://parkedhearts.itch.io/friendly-favours]Itch.io[/url]]

你刚刚搬到一个城市，并结识了你的第一个朋友：来自你公寓楼的友好邻居，名叫Yuka。你们俩一拍即合，但最终你们会只是朋友，还是更多呢？
